stepTitle: With regularization hyper-parameter $$\lambda, $$ the objective function of this model is augmented by adding $$\lambda(\hat{\theta}_1+\hat{\theta}_2).$$
stepBody:
We now train the following model to predict self rating:
$$\hat{y}=\hat{	heta}_1x_1+\hat{	heta}_2x_1**{2}$$
where $$y$$ is self rating and $$x_1$$ is critic $$1$$.
Evaluate the following statements about training this model with L1 regularization.
